whyItMatters: The lockfile records what Mix will fetch, so a name that only looks like the intended package is installed without any earlier review step. The name this rule expects is `httpoison`.
actions: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `httpoison`, correct it to that exact spelling.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm mix.lock no longer carries a locked package name in mix.lock within one edit of `httpoison`.
